verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's docs confirm it files Corporation (S corp/C corp) formations, including for founders raising investment, but the evidence pack never mentions Delaware-specific filings, bylaws, or initial board consent/resolutions as part of the incorporation package — those are staples of a 'full' startup incorporation kit but are absent here. One community comment even flags that LegalZoom's typical customer base and structure differ from what venture-track startups need (legalzoom-comm-8), reinforcing the gap rather than confirming the specific service. missing for 10: Delaware-specific filing details, bylaws drafting, initial board/organizational resolutions, independent corroboration of end-to-end startup incorporation workflow.
